title: HadoopDB: An Architectural Hybrid of MapReduce and DBMS Technologies for Analytical Workloads
authors: Azza Abouzeid, Kamil Bajda-Pawlikowski, Daniel Abadi, Avi Silberschatz, Alexander Rasin
description: Introduces HadoopDB, a hybrid analytical system that uses Hadoop as a fault-tolerant scheduler and network communication layer while pushing SQL query execution into per-node PostgreSQL instances, approaching the performance of parallel databases while retaining the scalability and fault tolerance of MapReduce.
